purpose: Accepted qmllint findings. CI builds the ss_qmllint target, normalizes each finding to '<path> :: <message>' (line numbers are dropped: they churn on every edit above the warning) and fails on anything not listed here. Spec 0075, findings G12 / M7 -- the repo had no QML tier at all, so binding loops and unqualified access were caught only by someone noticing a runtime warning.
seed_instructions: The list below is empty because it has to be produced by a machine with Qt's qmllint, which the agent that added this gate could not run.
To arm the gate: configure any tree (e.g. cmake -G Ninja -B build/dev -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug),
paste the normalized findings the CI step prints into 'accepted', and set 'seeded' to true.
Until 'seeded' is true the CI step reports the findings and does not fail, so an unseeded baseline cannot redden a build over warnings nobody has read yet.
